chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla, from al-Washsha', from Aban ibn 'Uthman, from Abi Maryam, who said:
I said to Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام:
What do you say regarding the urine of riding animals and their droppings?
He said: As for their urine, then wash it if it touches you; and as for their droppings, they are of lesser concern than that.

key_terms.أَبْوَالِ: urine; here, the urine of riding animals
key_terms.أَكْثَرُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ: of lesser concern than that; indicating greater leniency in comparison
key_terms.إِنْ أَصَابَكَ: if it touches you or reaches you
key_terms.الدَّوَابِّ: riding animals or beasts of burden
key_terms.فَاغْسِلْ: wash it; an instruction to cleanse what was affected

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the urine and droppings of riding animals in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about contact with the urine and droppings of riding animals. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instructs that urine should be washed if it reaches a person, while droppings are treated more leniently in comparison.
